title: [E-Documents] Add support for credit memos, recognised from the PDF and applied to the original invoice
summary: E-Documents now recognizes vendor credit notes from PDFs and automatically creates purchase credit memos applied to the original invoice, eliminating manual rework when credit notes are received.
key_points: Credit notes (document type 381) are recognized and create purchase credit memos instead of invoices
Extraction returns EN 16931 document type codes and billing references to distinguish credit notes from invoices
Credit memos are automatically applied only to matching open invoices from the same pay-to vendor in applicable currencies
Draft includes editable 'Applies-to Vendor Inv. No.' field and read-only outcome field explaining what will happen
Negative amounts are normalized and multiple validation checks prevent incorrect applications
